عَرَكِىٌّ : see عَرَكٌ, in two places. ＝
-A2- عَرَكِيَّةٌ A vitious, or an immoral, or unrighteous, woman; or an adulteress, or a fornicatress. (O, K.) ―
-b2- And A thick, gross, coarse, or rude, woman; as also ↓ عَرَكَانِيَّةٌ . (K, TA. [The latter thus expl. in the O, and, as is said in the TA, on the authority of Ibn-'Abbád: in my MS. copy of the K written عَرْكَانِيَّةٌ; and in the CK, عَرَنِيَّة.])
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
